info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Loyalty Loyalty Balances-v1-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Balance Retrieval API allows clients to access the current loyalty balances of their customers seamlessly. This endpoint serves as a resource for businesses looking to manage and display loyalty program information effectively. Typical consumers include loyalty program managers and customer service applications that require real-time balance checks. By using this API, organizations can enhance customer engagement and inform users of their loyalty status promptly.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current loyalty balance associated with a user's account. It provides insights into the number of loyalty points available for the user, enabling them to make informed decisions about their rewards usage.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the loyalty balance. This body may contain information needed to specify the account or user for which the balance is requested.

ListLoyaltyLoyaltyBalancesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation to retrieve the loyalty balance. The expected value is a string.
